verdict.rationale: Stable sells a nationwide registered agent service with instant digital access to state and legal mail. Its docs describe adding a registered agent Location to an existing Organization, created by 2-letter state code, so a company can receive service of process alongside its CMRA mailbox locations on the same account. missing for 10: pricing or plan details showing how registered agent is bundled with or added to a mailbox plan, any description of how served documents are handled or escalated, independent or hands-on corroboration.
